title: nymphaea alba var. oocarpa
intro: Nymphaea alba var. oocarpa, commonly known as White Water Lily, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Nymphaea genus. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of White Water Lily include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects.
